description: Bounded negative result for intent i014 (branch helper-param-null-deref, snapshot s01 only). (5) ctnetlink_parse_zone is NULL-tolerant by construction ('if (attr)'). (7) nft_ct key/dreg derefs covered by nft_ct_select_ops' 'if (tb[NFTA_CT_KEY] == NULL) return ERR_PTR(-EINVAL)' (734). (8) br_parse_vlan_tunnel_info (br_netlink_tunnel.c:219) receives attr only from nla_for_each_nested iteration. (9) seg6_local parse_nla_bpf and siblings (839) are dispatched by parse_nla_action which checks 'if (!attrs[i]) return -EINVAL' (958-960) before param->parse. (10) fou.c parse_nl_config (671) wraps every dereference in its own presence test.
